query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM users u
            JOIN user_roles r ON r.id = u.role_id
            WHERE u.current_sign_in_at IS NOT NULL
              AND u.current_sign_in_at >= $3
              AND (
                  r.permissions & $1 = $1
                  OR r.permissions & $2 <> 0
              )
        ) AS "exists!"
